scope: CPU offline conversion of existing local native simulated demonstration; no new simulation or training
excluded_first_transition: No saved measured pre-observation at t=0; do not fabricate one
action_semantics: absolute EE pose target and gripper setpoint before IK; not measured velocity, not actuator torque
state_semantics: observed pose only; velocities, fluid field, EE orientation and controller history absent; not a Markov state claim
timing: observations from row i-1 precede action stored in row i; next observations from row i after 10ms native dynamics
split: candidate_demonstration_only; no random temporal train/test split, no heldout evaluation, no model update
cohort: local_UR5e_r9_240particles_dt0.000125; separate from later refined1920 experiments
limitations: One posthoc selected successful local scripted demonstration, not success-rate evidence
Data derived from local 240-particle Warp/MuJoCo simulation, not original authors assets
Observed numerical/contact gates do not validate real water or continuous collision freedom
No learned full-workflow rollout, cross-robot transfer, perception or real-world validation

negative_cross_split_same_parent.reason: Parent trajectory appears in multiple splits

negative_shifted_time.reason: Post-action timestamps are not consecutive 100 Hz

official_sample_scope: Public platform examples, not the Auto-Engineering original policy, GELLO, video-to-sim or deployment implementations.
